create_VectorEnv: create a VectorEnv with multiple parallelized Habitat environments using a custom make_env_fn and env_fn_args
reset_VectorEnv: reset all vectorized environments in a VectorEnv instance and collect observation results from each worker
step_VectorEnv: step all vectorized environments in a VectorEnv with a list of actions and collect observations and rewards
call_VectorEnv: call an arbitrary function by name on a specific environment in a VectorEnv and retrieve the result
render_VectorEnv: render observations from all vectorized environments as a tiled image in human or rgb_array mode
